'''Blba trees''' were relatively short, sturdy and thorny [[Tree/Legends|trees]] that dotted the [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] surface of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. After the [[Bombing of Telos IV]], a number of them could be found on [[Citadel Station]], an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that served as the staging area for the [[Telosian Restoration Project|restoration efforts]]. In that period, flora and fauna native to Dantooine were being studied by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Pato Ado]], a [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologist]] of [[Chodo Habat's herd]].<ref name="KOTOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> They apparently had sharp branches because the predator snail ate birds that were impaled on them.

The blba trees can grow for hundreds of years, and some revered ones have served as [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]] sites for several generations of family lineages. Dantooinians regard them as apt symbols for the planet's residents for being hardy, requiring little to thrive, and being incredibly difficult to move once their roots develop.<ref name="CX">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Blba Tree}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine]]'', they are misspelled as '''biba trees'''.
